Quotes
NINJATRADER 8 ONLY

This legacy account-scoped quote route reads from the connected NT8 data feed through /v1/api and supports the NT8 WebSocket API. It is not available under /v1/api/tv.

GET Quote: Returns the current quote of the specified instrument from the data feed/connection of the given account.
